facts.business: Quadrant Future Tek Limited is a research-oriented, technology-driven engineering company operating in Specialty Cables and Train Control & Signalling Systems for railways, defence, renewable energy, and electric mobility.

auditor.name: M/s. Girish Madan & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter on consecutive financial losses for FY2025 and FY2026, cash loss of Rs. 310.22 million in FY2026, and advice to review operational strategies and cost structures.

key_risks: Persistence of financial losses over consecutive years
Cash loss of Rs. 310.22 million in FY2026 indicating insufficient operational revenues to meet cash expenditures
Delays in execution of high-value projects
Increased operational and development costs for advanced railway signalling and train protection solutions
Time taken for obtaining necessary approvals and certifications for commercialization of TCAS project
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were within limits approved by the audit committee and Board, conducted at arm's length and in ordinary course of business. No material transactions requiring shareholders' approval. Details disclosed in Note No. 31 to financial statements.
